heading: Κεφ. βʹ. — CHAP. II.
paragraphs:
P. 4, 1.36.—“thou shalt not corrupt boys”] The παιδεραστία
of Classic writers, referred to by Paul in Rom. i.27.

P. 6, 1.42, 43.—“διγλωσσία”] This noun does not occur in
Classic Greek, nor in the New Testament, but is found,
together with the entire sentence in which it here stands, in the
Epistle of Barnabas, Chap. xix. There are many other
correspondences between that epistle and the present document.

P. 6, 1.44.—“filled with doing”] i.e., works, deeds, as in
Matt. xvi. 27.
